NOT overridden: uuid@8.3.2 under jayson under @solana/web3.js — the advisory is a bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when the caller supplies a buffer, and jayson only calls v4() with no buffer, so the code is unreachable. Forcing uuid 11 is a major bump across a CJS/ESM boundary to fix a path that cannot be hit. The real fix is the @solana/web3.js v2 migration. See docs/SECURITY.md.
